Recovery from Stroke with Cayenne Protocol

Testimonial stroke cayenne first-aid emergency

Evidence: testimonial

Summary

A family member describes using cayenne pepper tincture during a suspected ischemic event while awaiting emergency services, reporting improved responsiveness.

Subject Type: remedy

Subject ID: remedy_001

Experience

My father had a sudden onset of confusion and weakness on one side. While waiting for the ambulance, I administered cayenne tincture sublingually. By the time paramedics arrived, he was more alert and able to speak in full sentences. The hospital confirmed a minor ischemic event with no major residual damage.

Outcome

Improved responsiveness during acute event; no major residual neurological damage per hospital assessment.
